title: Quadratic gate coordinate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and let $i$ be a gate index. Among the $1+n+g$ coordinates consisting of one constant coordinate, the $n$ input coordinates, and the $g$ gate coordinates, the coordinate assigned to gate $i$ is the $(1+n+i)$-th coordinate, with indexing starting at zero.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates
